scientific_question: Can a probe chosen using independent prior PhysX response calibration improve selective ACK-history identification when the previously easy high-SNR fault is attenuated? Does added actuation justify any saved privileged reads?
calibration_scope: 8 genuine physical resets per robot; two genuine ACK truth conditions and each of three genuine probes per reset. Frozen old classifier fit separately per robot and probe (no hidden truth during heldout decisions).
selection_rule: For each robot, fit calibration response means/radii independently for x and y. Choose the nonzero probe maximizing mean(applied)-mean(held) L2 gap minus sum of both empirical envelopes, lexicographic tie-break. Freeze selection before any heldout PHY outcomes. Compare chosen probe against fixed x, fixed y, and zero. This is calibration-selected per robot, NOT online per-state optimization.
claim_limit: Nonzero probes x and y equal native6 L2 norm, but zero has less actuation. Every candidate uses the same four native PhysX steps. No measured work, force, collision, contact, pretrained PPO, or robust sensor-noise guarantee.
heldout_metrics: selected versus zero/fixed X/fixed Y: unique admitted labels, false confident labels, abstentions, actual t4 setpoint correction errors
heldout public applied/held response separation by robot/probe
calibration-only separation score, actual native6 probe magnitude, full denominator incl refusals
any differences in t1 achieved XYZ across paired physical truth/probe worlds
hard_veto: never use heldout labels in selection or fitting
do not treat 96 new worlds as 96 independent reset seeds
do not interpret classification of t2 ACK as full manipulation task success
do not call empirical radii physical safety certificates
do not claim calibrated nonzero beats zero if all outcomes tie or wrong labels appear
no official external upsteam merge or third-party experiment
if physical source validation fails preserve all failure logs; no posthoc remapping seeds/probes
cross_platform_source: Python 3.11 GitHub Ubuntu native ManiSkill PhysX CPU
original 0.08 fault scaling ONLY, original t0/t1 actions and native controller charts pinned by SHA
